data.title: Tretinoin 0.025% (and 0.05%, 0.1%)
data.summary: VII Anti-acne — Retinoids · First-generation topical retinoid (all-trans retinoic acid)
data.body:
_Topicals · VII Anti-acne — Retinoids_

**Class:** First-generation topical retinoid (all-trans retinoic acid)

## Mechanism of action
- Binds all three nuclear RAR receptors (α, β, γ) → normalises follicular keratinisation (comedolytic; prevents microcomedones)
- Increases cell turnover; anti-inflammatory (reduces TLR-2 expression)
- Increases dermal collagen and disperses melanin (photoageing, pigmentation)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Acne vulgaris (comedonal and inflammatory) — first-line with BPO; maintenance after control
- Photoageing (fine wrinkles, mottled pigmentation), melasma (in triple combination), PIH
- Flat warts, keratosis pilaris, molluscum (adjunct), striae (early)

## Dose & formulations
- Pea-sized amount for the whole face at night, on dry skin, 20–30 min after washing
- Start with 0.025% cream on alternate nights, increase as tolerated
- Photolabile and oxidised by BPO — apply at night and separately from BPO (micronised/microsphere forms are more stable)

## Adverse effects
- Retinoid dermatitis (redness, peeling, burning) in the first 2–4 weeks
- Initial flare of acne ('purge'), photosensitivity (thinned stratum corneum)
- Hypo- or hyperpigmentation (dark skin)

## Contraindications
- Pregnancy (avoid as a precaution), eczema, sunburn, rosacea (relative)

## Drug interactions
- BPO inactivates it (if applied together); other irritants (abrasive soaps, astringents, peels) increase irritation

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid in pregnancy (minimal absorption, but retinoid class — not recommended); azelaic acid is a safer alternative.

## Viva points
- Binds RAR-α, β, γ (adapalene and tazarotene are RAR-β/γ selective)
- Photolabile and oxidised by BPO — apply at night
- Expect irritation and early flare — counsel patients

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.46 (Topical retinoids); Khopkar ch.24. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
